basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Same male cultivator as reference, chibi 2.7 heads tall, readable at 80px. Simplify clothing to 3 large solid masses, just 2-3 broad folds per garment, no embroidery no gold no jewellery no tiny straps no patterned cloth, hair in 3 large clumps. Clear continuous thick dark navy OUTER OUTLINE around whole silhouette, lighter thin interior lines; restrained cel watercolor, pale blue shadow planes. Facing right three-quarter elevated game view. True transparent alpha, no ground no shadows no environment no text no effects, no fringe, no cropping or cell overlap. Each pose has LARGE obvious changes in silhouette, torso angle and arms. Exact same character outfit throughout.
